title: Schema composition and inference: Compose strict schemas with safeExtend and derive TS types via z.infer; reject unknown keys and out-of-range domain fields.
description: Zod 4 schema design with actual runtime parsing, negative test cases, a deliberately broken learner implementation, instructor solution and security boundaries.
